title: SSC MTS Full Length Mock Test 04 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC MTS. 90 Questions | 90 Minutes | Numerical 20, Reasoning 20, GA 25, English 25. 3 marks each.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 90 questions: Numerical Ability 20, Reasoning 20, General Awareness 25, English 25.
Har question 3 marks ka hai. Session-II pattern ke anusar galat jawab par 1 mark kat sakta hai.
Time: 90 minutes (Session-I 45 min + Session-II 45 min combined mock).
SSC MTS latest CBT pattern ke anusar.

questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a boy, Rina said, 'He is the son of my mother's only son.' How is the boy related to Rina?
questions.explanation: Mother's only son is Rina's brother; his son is Rina's nephew.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: East and West cancel; remaining 6 km North.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: No definite relation between pens and tables; II is reverse and false.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 9th letter from the left in English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 9th letter is I; 4th to its right is M.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word 'SMART' is seen in a mirror placed to the right, the last letter from the left of the image is?
questions.explanation: Right-placed vertical mirror reverses order: TRAMS, leftmost of image is T? Wait vertical mirror to the right reverses left-right so SMART → TRAMS, first from left is T. Question says last letter from the left of the image = last of TRAMS = S. Yes S.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: A person can be male doctor-engineer; all three can overlap.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. A is left of B but right of C. D is right of B. E is between B and D. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order C-A-B-E-D; middle is B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not leap affecting Aug after Feb; 1 year = +1 day → Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 are the hands at right angle first?
questions.explanation: Right angle at 3: (90×1)/5.5 min ≈ 16 4/11 min.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: 'Use our fertilizer to double your crop.' Assumption: Farmers want more crop.
questions.explanation: Advertisement assumes farmers desire higher yield.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 11th from left and Seema is 15th from right. How many between them?
questions.explanation: Positions: Ravi 11, Seema 26 from left (40-15+1). Between = 26-11-1=14.
